findings.title: Malformed project config can be returned as a successful error-context build
findings.description: `readAdoptionState` lets malformed TOML parsing errors propagate without wrapping them as `AdoptionError`. This catch rethrows only `AdoptionError`; other errors are converted into an error-context string. Consequently, a build with malformed `.context-forge.toml` can return that stub as if generation succeeded instead of failing, unlike invalid adoption-state values and source-volume failures, which are reported as `AdoptionError`.

findings.title: Adoption guide validation rejects CRLF profile files
findings.description: The profile check relies on `ContextProfileParser.parseProfiles`, which searches for the exact string `context_profiles:\n`. A guide with CRLF line endings contains `context_profiles:\r\n`, so parsing returns no profiles and this check rejects the guide as missing the `brownfield-adoption` profile—even when the profile is present. Normalize line endings or make the profile parser accept CRLF, and cover this format in a test.
